en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued this afternoon
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning around 1.15pm as heat-stress levels rose under the ongoing Very Hot Weather Warning, advising employers to arrange rest breaks for outdoor and…
body: The Labour Department issued the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning in the early afternoon on Friday, indicating that heat stress in some working environments was relatively high. The warning comes while the Hong Kong Observatory’s Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force.

Employers are reminded to follow the department’s guidelines on preventing heat stroke at work. Measures include rearranging work schedules, providing shaded rest areas, ensuring adequate ventilation and arranging appropriate rest periods according to the level of physical labour.

Workers who develop symptoms such as headache, dizziness, thirst or nausea should move to a cool place, drink water and notify their supervisor immediately. The Observatory has also warned that extremely hot conditions are expected to continue over the weekend, with temperatures in parts of the New Territories possibly reaching 36 degrees or above.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告下午生效
zh.dek: 勞工處下午約1時15分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境熱壓力頗高；酷熱天氣警告同時生效，僱主應安排適當休息時間。
body: 勞工處周五下午約1時15分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。天文台的酷熱天氣警告繼續生效。
勞工處提醒僱主參照《預防工作時中暑指引》，在合理地切實可行的情況下採取防暑措施，包括重新編排工作時段、提供遮蔭休息地方、加強通風，並按體力勞動程度安排適當休息時間。
僱員如出現頭痛、頭暈、口渴或噁心等不適，應立即到陰涼處休息及飲水，並通知僱主或主管。天文台預料周末高溫持續，新界部分地區氣溫可達36度或以上。
